review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, the two stable task keys, verification dependency, exact writable owner scope, readiness and evidence stages agree. The implementation evidence supports a read-only derived count without a second counter or scheduling changes; AC-002 correctly preserves completed/error event observations and the existing deferred pending update, with final zero checked after onIdle. The build configuration supports generated dist declarations rather than a separately maintained declaration owner. The supplied nz implementation establishes discovery and compiler checking of test-d/index.test-d.ts despite the source-only tsconfig include; runtime tests and source-only tsc are not substitutes for that type regression. Task eligibility is supported by the supplied project-scoped active trusted claims, delivery roles, memberships and capacity, including data.change and integration.consumer for both roles and testing.verification for the verifier. Pending legacy claims and Persona are not used as capability evidence. The configured selected verifier can satisfy the independent read-only planning-review prerequisite under the supplied policy. No material unresolved DEC-001 is present in this case, and no hypothetical C is treated as a human Decision. Repository, source, team, decision, prompt/build, model, sampling, budget and metric-policy fingerprints are consistent across the supplied frozen records; the distinct source digest domains and PRD trimming are explained. Original preparation placeholders do not contradict expected planning readiness. This review uses only the supplied pre-candidate evidence, makes no new human attestation, and neither executes code nor independently recomputes Service-calculated digests.
